name: ms-graph-mcp
description: Read your own Microsoft 365 — Outlook mail and calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams chat, To Do, Planner — from Claude Code, through Microsoft Graph with delegated permissions.

client_id.title: Application (client) ID
client_id.description: The Entra application this server signs in with. Register one at https://entra.microsoft.com under App registrations, add the redirect URI http://localhost under 'Mobile and desktop applications', and set 'Allow public client flows' to Yes. There is no shared application to fall back on.

tenant_id.title: Directory (tenant) ID
tenant_id.description: Your organisation's tenant ID. Leave blank for 'common', which suits most work accounts; use 'consumers' for a personal Microsoft account.

groups.title: Tool groups
groups.description: Comma-separated product areas to enable: me, mail, calendar, files, todo, planner, contacts, chat, sharepoint, search, teams, directory, intune. Leave blank for the personal set. The scopes requested at sign-in are derived from this, so a narrower list means a narrower consent prompt.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Set to 1 to remove every tool that writes — no sending mail, no deleting files — and to drop the write scopes from the consent request. Recommended until you need otherwise.
